title: Jumpstart Your Job Search – Teal Webinar – September 18th
description:
Looking to understand more about tailoring your resume from the experts?Want to learn more about Teal? 

Every week, we host a live webinar to help you use Teal tools to your advantage while job searching and applying. 

This week's live webinar was hosted by our VP of Marketing, Lia Zneimer, and Recruiter and Social Media Manager, Leah Dillon. Together they shared insights and advice about tailoring your resume for the role and highlighting key accomplishments relevant to the job description.

Whether it's building your resume, searching for the right job, or marketing yourself for the role you want, we've got you covered with tools like our FREE Chrome Extension, Job Tracker, and Resume Builder. We'll walk through everything you can do for free and highlight what the Teal+ subscription covers.

These webinars will share similar information and tips every week, so if you're unable to join live, watch past episodes here on YouTube!
